common.offline: Numo9 couldn't be reached. Make sure you're online, then try again.
common.passwordTooShort: Use at least 12 characters. A few unrelated words work well.
common.rateLimited: Too many attempts. For your security, wait {minutes, plural, one {# minute} other {# minutes}} before trying again.
common.serverError: Something went wrong on our side and nothing was changed. Try again in a moment.
common.unexpected: That didn't work (error {status}). Try again; if it keeps happening, contact support.

login.locked: Too many failed sign-ins. For your security, this account is locked for {minutes, plural, one {# minute} other {# minutes}}. You can reset your password now to unlock it.
login.mismatch: The email or password is incorrect. Try again, or reset your password if you've forgotten it.
login.resetDone: Your password was changed and every session was signed out. Sign in with your new password.
login.title: Sign in to Numo9
login.verifyFirst: Verify your email address first. We've emailed a new link to {email} — open it, then sign in.

password.hint: At least 12 characters. A few unrelated words make a strong, memorable password.
password.strength: Password strength: {strength, select, tooShort {too short} fair {fair} good {good} strong {strong} other {}}

reset.deadBody: Reset links work once and for 1 hour, and stop working when the password changes. Request a new link.
reset.deadTitle: This reset link doesn't work any more
reset.lead: For {email}. Saving it signs you out on every device; then you sign in with the new password.
reset.mismatch: The two passwords are different. Type the same password in both fields.
reset.requestLead: Enter the email you sign in with. We'll email you a link to choose a new password.
reset.sentBody: If {email} has a Numo9 account, a reset link is on its way. It works once, for 1 hour. Nothing arrived after a few minutes? Look in your spam folder, or request a new link.
reset.title: Choose a new password

signup.accountantDetail: Free for accountants, always. Set up your practice and invite your clients.
signup.alreadySignedIn: You're already signed in. Go to Home, or sign out first to create another account.
signup.chooseLead: Tell us who you are so we set up the right workspace.
signup.name: Your name
signup.nameRequired: Enter your full name, e.g. 'Dana Lee'.
signup.organisationDetail: Start a 30-day free trial for your organisation. No card needed to start.
signup.organisationHint: You can add the legal name, BN and Province later.
signup.organisationRequired: Enter your business name, e.g. 'Refined Interiors Inc.'.
signup.practiceHint: As your clients know it, e.g. 'Maple Leaf Accounting'.
signup.practiceRequired: Enter your practice's name, e.g. 'Maple Leaf Accounting'.
signup.sentBody: We sent a link to {email}. Open it within 3 days to verify your address — then you can sign in.
signup.sentSpam: Nothing after a few minutes? Look in your spam or junk folder. If the address was mistyped, sign up again with the right one.
signup.sentTitle: Open the link we emailed you

twoFactor.codeIncomplete: Enter all 6 digits of the code.
twoFactor.expired: Your sign-in timed out before the code was entered. Sign in again.
twoFactor.lead: Open your authenticator app and enter the 6-digit code it shows for Numo9.
twoFactor.lostDevice: Lost your phone and your recovery codes? Ask your practice admin or Numo9 support to reset two-factor authentication — they will confirm who you are first.
twoFactor.noPendingBody: There's no sign-in waiting for a code in this browser — it may have timed out. Sign in with your email and password, then enter the code.
twoFactor.recoveryHint: Looks like k7m2p-x9qrt. Capitals and dashes don't matter.
twoFactor.recoveryLead: Enter one of the 10 recovery codes you saved when you set up two-factor authentication. Each code works once.
twoFactor.rememberHint: Only on a computer or phone that you alone use.
twoFactor.title: Enter your authentication code
twoFactor.useApp: Use the code from your authenticator app
twoFactor.wrongCode: That code didn't work. Codes change every 30 seconds — enter the one your app shows now, and make sure your phone's clock is set automatically.
twoFactor.wrongRecovery: That recovery code didn't work. It may have been used already — each code works once. Try another one.

verify.invalidBody: Verification links work once and for 3 days. If you already verified, just sign in. Otherwise sign in anyway — we'll email you a new link.
verify.invalidTitle: This link doesn't work any more
verify.verifiedSignIn: Sign in with your email and password to continue.
verify.verifiedSignedIn: You're signed in. Your workspace is ready.

form.leaveBody: Your changes on this page will be lost.

notFound.body: The address may be mistyped, or the page may have moved. Search for the page or go to Home.

search.label: Search pages
search.noResults: No matching pages. Try another word.

notFound.title: We can't find that page

orgSwitcher.error: Your organisations couldn't be loaded. Make sure you're online, then try again.
orgSwitcher.moreResults: Showing {shown, number} of {total, number}. Refine your search or open the directory.
orgSwitcher.noResults: No organisations match. Try another spelling, or open the directory.
